definitions.explanation: The activity of flying a kite, traditionally associated with the New Year in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{凧揚|たこあ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I flew kites at New Year's.

examples.japanese: ⟦{河川敷|かせんしき}→河川敷：24122_kasenshiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{凧揚|たこあ}げ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{最適|さいてき}→最適：13010_saiteki⟧な⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧だ。

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{凧揚|たこあ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。

notes:
CULTURAL CONTEXT: {凧揚|たこあ}げ is one of the traditional New Year (⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧) activities in Japan, along with ⟦{羽根|はね}つき→羽根つき：07129_hanetsuki⟧ (Japanese badminton), ⟦{福笑|ふくわら}い→福笑い：07130_fukuwarai⟧ (pin-the-face game), and {独楽回|こままわ}し (top spinning).

TRADITIONAL KITES:
- {和凧|わだこ}: traditional Japanese kite
- {連凧|れんだこ}: train of connected kites
- {奴凧|やっこだこ}: kite shaped like a servant figure

SEASONAL ASSOCIATION:
- Most strongly associated with New Year
- Also enjoyed in spring when winds are favorable
- Some regions have kite festivals ({凧揚|たこあ}げ⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧)

RELATED WORDS:
- {凧|たこ}: kite
- {凧糸|たこいと}: kite string
- {凧|たこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揚|あ}げる→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧: to fly a kite
